items.headline: <US Stock Weekly Theme> Energy Storage Systems - TSLA, ENPH, RUN
items.snippet: Benchmark raised the 2026 global lithium carbonate equivalent demand by 12% to 2.1 million tons, with new demand from battery energy storage systems revised upward from 92,000 tons to 270,000 tons.
